settings.title: Plugin Settings
settings.lang.name: Interface language
settings.lang.desc: Choose the plugin interface language. Takes effect immediately.
toast.langFailed: Failed to switch interface language. Please retry.
settings.sidebar.name: Folder tree width
settings.sidebar.desc: In px, range {min}–{max}. Takes effect after clicking "Save".
settings.bodyH.name: Content area height
settings.bodyH.desc: Height of the container holding the folder tree and the LoRA card area, in px, range {min}–{max}. Takes effect after clicking "Save".
settings.folderCards.name: Show folder cards
settings.folderCards.desc: When off, folder cards are hidden from the card list (the folder tree still navigates normally).
settings.previews.name: Card image preview
settings.previews.desc: When off, preview images are not used even if present; a "No cover" placeholder is shown instead.
settings.allModels.name: Show all models under folder
settings.allModels.desc: When on, the card list recursively shows models in all subfolders of the current path without searching.
settings.searchSub.name: Search subfolders
settings.searchSub.desc: When on, the search covers all subfolders of the current path (recursive).
settings.onlyLora.name: Only search LoRA models
settings.onlyLora.desc: When on, search results show only model files, without folder cards.
settings.ratio.name: Aspect ratio presets
settings.ratio.desc: Adjust the height to the selected ratio; the width keeps its current value.
settings.lockRatio.name: Lock aspect ratio
settings.lockRatio.desc: When on, changing the width or height automatically updates the other to keep the current ratio.
settings.cardSize.name: Card size
settings.mode.name: Translation mode
settings.mode.desc: Hybrid: look up the built-in dictionary first, then translate missing tags with the GGUF model. Dictionary-only never calls the model and shows "Not translated" for missing tags.
settings.llm.name: llama_cpp model
settings.llm.desc: Training tags are translated by the selected GGUF model first; if no model is selected or loading fails, it falls back to the built-in dictionary.
settings.llm.openFolderTitle: Open the model's folder in the file explorer
settings.llm.selectAria: Select the GGUF model used for tag translation
settings.device.name: Inference device
settings.device.desc: CPU uses no VRAM and does not interfere with image generation; GPU translation is faster (within ~10s) but keeps the model in VRAM (~2.5GB). It falls back to CPU automatically when VRAM is insufficient.
settings.runtime.name: Translation runtime
settings.runtime.desc: The CPU build is installed offline with the plugin and works out of the box. For GPU acceleration, download the CUDA build (~490MB) here: after the download finishes, restart WebUI to install and apply it. The CUDA build also includes the CPU backend, so it still falls back to CPU when VRAM is insufficient.
settings.runtime.install: Install the CUDA build to use GPU inference
settings.idle.name: Auto-unload when idle
settings.idle.desc: After translation, if no new translation occurs for the set duration, the model's VRAM/memory is released automatically; the next translation reloads it (a few seconds on GPU). Range {min}–{max} minutes.
settings.idle.label: Idle
settings.download.name: Download GGUF model
settings.download.desc: Enter an HF repo ID or URL. The network is probed automatically: the official site is preferred, falling back to the hf-mirror mirror on timeout or failure.
settings.download.detectTitle: Read the available GGUF files in this repo
settings.download.fileAria: Select the GGUF file to download
settings.download.downloadTitle: Download the selected model to the LLM directory
settings.prompt.name: Translation prompt preset
settings.prompt.desc: The prompt used by model translation. Switching the dropdown takes effect immediately; "Default" is built in and cannot be overwritten or deleted.
settings.promptName.name: Preset name
settings.promptName.desc: The preset name used when saving. It overwrites an existing preset of the same name; up to {max} characters.
settings.promptName.saveTitle: Save the current prompt text as a new preset
settings.promptText.name: Preset prompt text
settings.promptText.desc: Must contain the {tags} placeholder, which is replaced with the list of tags to translate.
settings.oldData.desc: When a model is moved or renamed in the LoRA directory, its card data (description, trigger words, tag translations, etc.) becomes orphaned due to the path change. Clicking the button matches primarily by hash (the model's fingerprint), falling back to filename + file size when no hash is available, then migrates the old data to the model's current location and syncs statistics such as usage count. Unmatched old data is listed below for manual cleanup.
settings.oldData.run: Scan and migrate orphaned card data
settings.oldData.unmatchedDesc: The following old data has no corresponding model file in the LoRA directory (it may have been deleted or renamed). If you confirm it is unneeded, you can clean it up manually in the models_json_data directory.
settings.sync.desc: Read the same-named JSON generated by the old sd_forge_lora plugin in the models/Lora directory (same directory and name as the model file), and sync its description, base model, trigger words, preferred weight, negative prompt, and notes into this plugin's card data. The old JSON is not deleted; when both old and new JSONs have content, it is not overwritten automatically but listed below for you to decide.
settings.sync.run: Sync LoRA JSON into this plugin
settings.sync.conflictsDesc: Both the old and new JSON of these models already have content, so automatic sync was skipped. Clicking "Overwrite" overwrites the corresponding fields in this plugin with the old JSON's data (training tags and translations are unaffected).
